README.licenseExactSentence: CPF는 **Community & Evaluation License** 안내를 기준으로 사용합니다.
README.manualNavigation: mandatory near bottom; role-based links with one-line Korean purpose
README.bootstrapRuntimeBlock: mandatory near bottom; Bootstrap/Build/Test/Runtime commands verified from current source
README.gatewayOptionalityVisual: mandatory; selected vs not-selected comparison; internal domain-to-domain path MUST NOT traverse Gateway
README.valueHighlights: one message per line with visible bullet/marker; dense bold phrase chain forbidden
README.visualBalance: all major sections/visuals: balanced whitespace and visual weight; no accidental one-side crowding/dead space
README.figureGeometry: all labels inside nodes with safe padding; no title/label/connector overlap
README.subheadingContentRail: H2/H3 content visually indented/grouped relative to heading; semantic Markdown grouping, not code-space indentation
README.subheadingContentGap: heading-to-first-content compact; next-heading gap visibly larger
README.visualSurfaceOnDark: major diagrams use light/neutral/tinted canvas or bright focal surface; dark-on-dark hard_fail
README.visualGrammarDiversity: concept-specific visual grammar; rounded-box+arrow chain is not default; at least 4 distinct visual grammars when README has 5+ visuals
README.figureExplanationOwnership: figure explanation directly below same figure block; must not be visually closer to next section
README.documentFormatLinks: user navigation: [PDF] -> .pdf only; DOCX link forbidden; DOCX packaging remains required
README.incrementalImprovement: PATCH_FIRST; preserve previous PASS sections/visuals unless impacted; compare before/after for regression
README.surfaceDefinition: Host viewer background는 제어 불가. CPF 소유 Hero/주요 Content Surface는 dark brochure로 명확히 분리하고, Visual canvas는 light/neutral로 대비한다.

DOCX.toc: required H1/H2 with real page numbers
DOCX.h3Numbering: automatic local numbering when profile permits
DOCX.headingSpacing: H1/H2/H3 differentiated by design-tokens; dense uniform spacing hard_fail
DOCX.visualExplanation: 1-2 concise Korean sentences below informative figures
DOCX.pdfCrossRendererGlyph: minimum two independent renderers; Korean glyph must match/read correctly
DOCX.pageVisualBalance: mandatory on every page; headings/body/tables/figures/callouts balanced; accidental dead space hard_fail
DOCX.figureGeometry: node inner padding/label gap/connector clearance/title band follow design-tokens; overlap/crop/baseline drift hard_fail
DOCX.subheadingContentRail: H2/H3 content + bullets + callouts + figure explanation use 4.5mm content rail; full-width figure/table explicit exception only
DOCX.subheadingContentGap: H2 after <=6pt, H3 after <=5pt; next subsection separation larger
DOCX.figureExplanationOwnership: figure/caption/explanation stay one visual block; explanation closer to figure than next heading
DOCX.incrementalImprovement: PATCH_FIRST; unchanged PASS pages/visuals preserved; no unrelated redesign
DOCX.orientation: reader_first; landscape allowed/preferred for API/option/compare-heavy documents

finalReview.semantic: 각 문서의 독자가 실제 질문에 답할 수 있는지
finalReview.developerUtility: CRUD/Transaction/Error 등 핵심 개발 주제에서 Public API·옵션·선택 기준·실패/복구·최소 예를 첫 스캔으로 찾을 수 있어야 한다.
finalReview.gatewayTopology: 내부 Domain 간 호출이 Gateway를 경유한다고 오표현한 곳이 0건인지
finalReview.pdfCompatibility: 한글 Font embedding + 2개 렌더러 Glyph PASS
finalReview.visualBalance: 모든 문서의 전페이지와 모든 Figure에서 상하·좌우 밀도, whitespace, alignment, label/connector geometry를 실제 렌더로 확인
finalReview.readerNeed: 각 문서의 Persona가 왜 열었는지와 문서 종료 시 어떤 작업/판단을 끝내는지가 일치하는지 확인

appliesTo: temporary generated output used for delivery

finalQualityRule: 자동 Validator PASS만으로 완료 금지. HUMAN_VISUAL_PASS + REGRESSION_PASS + CLICK_THROUGH_PASS 필수.

layoutQuality.columnWidth: content/role aware; equal only when symmetric
layoutQuality.majorSectionBreathing: about one extra line before H1/major menu

sourceZipCompleteness.unicodeRoundTrip: canonical UTF-8/NFC path must match after Windows Expand-Archive
